role: Independent science, bibliography and bilingual editorial reviewer; not a writer of the reviewed manuscripts

checks.evidence: Both complete six-paragraph editorials begin with a concrete biomolecular electrostatics problem, develop the selected-output question, and connect it to photonic acquisition and the existing cost review. They are short editorial analyses, not copied titles/abstracts, an item list, or an archive-work report. No compulsory novelty or fixed-template claim is made.

The titles correspond to one another and to the molecular-potential emphasis. Both separate summaries explain the selected-output question and optical connection without claiming that the two platforms solve the same task or establish a common quantum advantage.

The text identifies a linearized continuum electrostatics model rather than electronic wavefunction simulation, classical molecular inputs, electrostatic-energy estimation and an environment difference for solvation. It conditions grid-scaling on fixed atom count, assigns the best inverse-error scaling to amplitude estimation, labels the normalized multigrid comparison, and does not claim a physical execution or hardware-qubit resource result.

The four-, two-, and one-photon protocol, three-bit output, postselected/postprocessed implementation instead of demonstrated real-time feed-forward, successfully collected-event comparison, raw versus DAE-corrected behavior, and simplified loss model are all distinguished. No total acquisition-time advantage, raw-data-code release or universal efficiency threshold is claimed.

The connection preserves the preparation/sampling/postprocessing question of the 9 September review and adds the definition of the chosen output. It explicitly keeps molecular energy error and sensor information separate. Local KO/EN canonical manuscript titles, dates and relevant passages agree; root separately verified the live EN H1.

The three references follow first use (LPB, QADC, existing review). All five LPB authors and all twelve QADC authors are retained in source order; source titles, arXiv v1, DOI, journal abbreviation and existing-review creation/revision dates match the checked records. No unassigned Nature Photonics volume/pages are fabricated. Citation anchors and English alternate link are consistent.

The two disclosures distinguish the actual agent roles and source scopes, label the final connection as editorial interpretation, retain issue/writing/evidence dates, identify Codex with unavailable exact model identifier, and make no experiment-reproduction or human-reader-study claim. This reviewer has now completed the nonauthor review attributed to it. Other agents remain responsible for their own PDF, systems and publication-verification statements.
